allowed_use: Define reproducible parameter ranges, model outputs, analysis-only contexts, and evidence-gap placeholders for Phase 2B sensitivity and Phase 2C identifiability analysis of the normalized Phase 0/1 ODE.

phase_boundary.phase2a_deliverable: Draft mapping from model parameters to potential observable classes and evidence gaps.
phase_boundary.phase2b_deliverable: Model-side sensitivity results with condition dependence reported explicitly.
phase_boundary.phase2c_deliverable: Identifiability analysis for parameters and parameter combinations under candidate observable classes.
phase_boundary.dbtl_handoff_gate: Concrete assays, experimental controls, sampling design, and experimental priorities require completed model-analysis gates plus the team-confirmed wet-lab plan, feasibility, cost, and resources.

transition_diagnostic_basis.rationale: At L=K_R the Hill output is 0.5 for every n_R; fixed flanking contexts keep log(L/K_R) non-zero without relying only on zero or saturated input.

design_contexts.matched_control_rule: In silico matched-control rule: for each positive-ligand parameter set, keep every numeric model field fixed and set only input.ligand_normalized to 0.0.

ratio_color_8h.invalid_when: denominator <= denominator_min_positive_value or matched control is unavailable
ratio_color_8h.interpretation: Use ratio_color_8h only when the validity flag is true; use delta_color_8h for absolute ligand-control separation when the ratio is invalid.

M1_dynamic_stf.activation_gate: High sTF-module influence plus an early intermediate time-course capable of separating sTF delay from color kinetics.

analysis_sequence.purpose: Check direction, scale, and numerical stability for all continuous fields across the primary and transition-diagnostic ligand contexts.
Rank main effects, nonlinearity, and interactions across primary and transition-diagnostic ligand contexts and copy strata, reporting the context classes separately.
Explain selected high-impact interactions with small interpretable grids.
Quantify variance contributions after the influential subset and independence assumptions are reviewed.

next_gate: Use this contract for Phase 2B sensitivity and Phase 2C identifiability. DBTL experiment-interface assembly begins after those model-analysis outputs and the team plan are jointly reviewed.
